general.launchAtLoginHint: Start File Chameleon in the background when you sign in.
general.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
general.closeToTrayHint: Off: closing the window quits the app.
general.contextMenuHint: Adds an entry that opens the wheel when you right-click files.
general.downloadQualityHint: Not used for audio and GIF downloads.
general.cookiesHint: Lets downloads use your signed-in session for sites that need it. Cookies are only read by the downloader on this device and never leave it.

appearance.uiScaleHint: Makes everything in the main window larger or smaller.
appearance.reduceMotionHint: Turns animations off so changes happen instantly.
appearance.wheelShowDetailHint: Slices show details such as quality, ratio or size.

shortcuts.enableHint: Hold Ctrl while dragging a file to open a wheel of formats.
shortcuts.anyAppHint: Off: only in File Explorer and the desktop.
shortcuts.flipScrollHint: While the wheel is open, scrolling switches between the front and back face.
shortcuts.shiftBackHint: Holding Shift together with Ctrl while dragging opens the wheel on its back face.
shortcuts.excluded: Apps where the wheel never opens
shortcuts.excludedHint: In these apps, Ctrl+drag works as usual.
shortcuts.howBody: Start dragging a file, press and hold Ctrl, then drop it on a format.

clipboard.enableHint: Saves what you copy so you can find it later.

engines.note: FFmpeg found on your PATH is used automatically. Download it here only if you do not have it.
engines.updated: {name} was updated to the latest version

purpose.deno: Script runtime some sites need for downloads

about.licensesValue: File Chameleon is open source. Optional engines keep their own licenses (FFmpeg: GPL-3.0, yt-dlp: Unlicense, PDFium: BSD-3-Clause, Deno: MIT).
about.credits: Inspired by Filee, Nashi and Clipboardline; not affiliated with them.
